thread:
maria: Heads up — after the rollout-tool v2 canary this morning I'm seeing org A's console fetches returning org B's insight rows intermittently :eyes:
devin: whoa, repro steps? are you on canary or did it hit prod buckets?
maria: canary only, traffic routed to canary host group 42. Steps: open Insights > select org A > sometimes the left panel shows cards from org B. Happens when switching tabs ~1-2s after nav.
sara: I noticed similar on my session. Might be an async prefetch race.
ashok: logging trace shows router middleware emitting header `x-org-context: org-a` but upstream internal-proxy reads `x-affinity` that can contain stale org id for pooled connections.
kyle: that's the affinity header change from rollout-tool v2, right? it switched from per-request to connection-affinity for perf.
maria: yes. I think per-connection affinity + shared HTTP keepalive is causing header leakage when we mutate connection-level metadata.
devin: can you paste the proxy forwarding snippet?
maria: ```
# from internal-proxy v2 rollout
req.headers['x-affinity'] = conn.metadata.affinityTag  # mutated in-place
proxy.forward(req)
```
ashok: aha — mutating a shared req or conn.metadata in-place without cloning racey when conn is reused.
sara: quick mitigation: don't mutate headers in-place, clone `req.headers` or reset affinity per-request.
kyle: also telemetry/quotas side-effect: quota keys are derived from `x-affinity` in the router, so wrong affinity -> wrong quota attribution. Billing impact if it spikes.
maria: confirmed — billing tagging and per-route SLO telemetry showed spikes in org B metrics during canary window.
devin: can we revert the affinity change for canary 42 and re-run?
deploy-bot: canary 42 promoted to prod at 09:12 UTC (triggered by rollout-tool).
sara: that explains why we saw traffic in prod too.
maria: I'm going to patch to defensive clone headers and add an assertion that `x-affinity` equals authenticated org header at boundary.
ashok: add a unit test that reuses a fake connection and toggles reqs quickly; should catch in CI.
kyle: also add a rolling canary check: compare per-org telemetry between canary and control after 5m, auto-halt if cross-org leakage > 0.1%.
devin: assigning follow-ups —
- maria: patch + hotfix PR (priority)
- ashok: telemetry diff alert config
- kyle: rollback canary 42 (if not already)
sara: +1 for alert and test.
maria: PR draft at https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987 — I'm shipping the clone + test.
devin: if someone can revert deploy-bot action that promoted 42, do it; otherwise we'll trigger emergency rollback.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for canary groups [42] — ETA 2m.
maria: thanks. Will follow up with postmortem and recommended guardrails for any connection-affinity changes.
sara: please include a checklist: header immutability, clone patterns, telemetry diff automation, canary guard thresholds.
kyle: thumbs up.
maria: logs and sample traces: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/trace/abc123 (redacted)
devin: good catch — let's not sleep on this one. :exclamation:
